import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes (mean difference in outcome groups)
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
            continue  # Skip clinical features for now
        group0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
        group1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
        effect_size = np.mean(group1) - np.mean(group0)
        effect_sizes.append((abs(effect_size), fid, i))
    
    # Sort by effect size (descending)
    effect_sizes.sort(reverse=True)
    
    # Select top features
    top_features = [fid for _, fid, _ in effect_sizes[:10]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    selected = []
    used = set()
    for fid in top_features:
        if fid in used:
            continue
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        corr_with_others = [abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col_idx], feats.x[:, feats.column(other_fid)])[0,1]) 
                           for other_fid in selected if other_fid != fid]
        if not corr_with_others or all(c < 0.6 for c in corr_with_others):
            selected.append(fid)
            used.add(fid)
        if len(selected) >= MAX_DRIVERS:
            break
    
    # For this problem, we'll return the strongest effect as driver
    drivers = tuple(selected)
    
    # All features with strong effect sizes
    columns = tuple([fid for _, fid, _ in effect_sizes[:10] if abs(_) > 0.1])
    
    # No products for simplicity
    products = ()
    
    # Weighted score using effect sizes
    loadings = {}
    for _, fid, i in effect_sizes[:10]:
        group0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
        group1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
        effect_size = np.mean(group1) - np.mean(group0)
        loadings[fid] = effect_size
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
